answer: A bonded escrow makes each identity costly to operate, but detection of coordinated equivocation imposes more than independent fines: for k linked identities, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), reflecting pairwise evidence and shared culpability. With asymmetric capital depreciation, repeated slashing compounds losses, so a sybil swarm faces an exponential multiplier in capital loss upon detection. The nadir of recoverable stake is reached swiftly; a trellis of aliases cannot hide their whisper of synchronized behavior.
